entities.name: Faculty of Dar Al-Uloom, Cairo University
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Dar al-Uloom is an educational institution designed to produce students with both an Islamic and modern secondary education. It was founded in 1871 and since 1946 it has been incorporated as a faculty of Cairo University, being now commonly called Faculty of Dar al-Uloom.
